evidence: Source-level review of the frozen agent environment found no finished solution, starter implementation, partial UI, application schema, answer-bearing archive, or rubric material. The actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx was opened using openpyxl: Quality Checks row 17 (quality number 16) states, 'The agent's world has the inputs and the ask, but no finished copy of the deliverable.' Internal Quality Checks row 17 repeats that statement without an added annotation. All workbook cell values were independently compared with rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/assets/WebDev_Rubrics_QC.xlsx and were identical. Deterministic Checks rows 9, 11 and 14 establish the related COPY/ADD and instruction-hygiene rules. The frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:70-71 requires an empty /app apart from .gitkeep and excludes starter/skeleton/schema/partial UI and criterion reproduction. All task citations below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task. environment/Dockerfile:14-15 contains exactly 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; there are no other COPY/ADD directives, remote downloads of task material, stage imports, or mounts. Lines 17-23 create /app and initialize Git with only .gitkeep; lines 25-26 set WORKDIR /app and sleep. The base is the standard node:22-bookworm-slim (line 1), and the only npm installations are Express and better-sqlite3 (lines 9-12). Recursive enumeration, including hidden objects and symlink checks, found exactly eight environment files: the Dockerfile, six Markdown notes, and the 198-byte seed_data.json; the additional assets/artifacts directory is empty. No symlinks exist anywhere in the frozen task. Every copied file was read in full. environment/assets/seed_data.json:2-4 contains only the product name, 'snippets': [], and the explanatory statement that no implementation or starter files are supplied. The notes specify requested behavior and runtime inputs, without code implementing it. instruction.md:5 says 'There isn't a starter app to finish'; environment/instructions/overview.md:9 likewise says no implementation or starter snippets were supplied. Public runtime requirements such as /app/server.js and GET /api/health in integration.md:5 are an interface contract, not a finished route implementation or a starter app. policy.md:5 explicitly leaves API routes and request fields to the implementer. All 73 criterion descriptions across the five judge.toml files were parsed and compared with the brief and all six notes: zero literal criterion-ID hits, zero matches for the inspected grader terms, and a maximum six-word contiguous normalized overlap ('copy of the last successful document'), which is ordinary shared product vocabulary rather than reproduced criterion text. task.toml:28 sets environment_mode = 'separate'; tests/Dockerfile:43 copies the tests only into the verifier image. solution/solve.sh:5-7 locates the separate golden app and line 26 copies it to /app only when the Oracle installer is invoked; that script is neither copied nor called by the agent Dockerfile. All eight environment SHA256 values match their manifest records, and both manifest.json and per-row-review/assignment.json name the assigned input hash. Runtime boundary: golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json identifies a direct Playwright golden run, not a solver-image inspection. Its executed drivers/launch_workflow.py:29-30 explicitly copies solution/app to a disposable runtime. That expected golden installation is not evidence of an agent-environment leak. No fresh container/image inspection was performed, and this Pass is limited to the fully inspected source build/copy graph; it does not certify an externally built image, hosted isolation, an Oracle score, or full configured judge execution.
counterexample: Conforming alternative considered: a solver receives the documented /api/health endpoint, /app/server.js entry path, and empty seed, then builds its own implementation. A literal rule rejecting every route name or every JSON seed would falsely fail this valid environment; the endpoint is explicitly part of the supplied runtime contract and the JSON contains no implementation. Broken alternative considered: retaining the same clean-looking Dockerfile while placing a finished app in assets/reference.zip or executable source in seed_data.json would leak it through COPY assets/ even without the words 'solution/' or 'tests/' in a directive. The complete copied-tree enumeration and full seed/notes inspection exclude that witness in this frozen candidate. These are source counterexamples, not executed container mutations and not observed defects.
